summary: Re-audit under T-02.2 rubric: Verified 5 ACs (AC-KB-01-01..05) and fail cases. Verified project isolation, append-only trigger, and RLS policies.

fail_cases_tested: AC-KB-01-02: Querying foreign project item returns NOT_FOUND indistinguishable from absent item
AC-KB-01-05: Declaration outside declared zone is rejected with OUT_OF_ZONE
BR-10: Attempted DELETE on declaration table is aborted by trigger

findings.description: RLS policy enforcement is verified in SQLite via application logic and trigger constraints; production PostgreSQL deployment requires explicit ALTER TABLE ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY verification during provisioning.
